# theme-ux-a11y spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog "blog" theme - responsive behavior and accessibility
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Phase**: Plan section 5.2 Phase 8 - "UI/UX"

---

## Purpose

Encode the UI/UX acceptance criteria in automation: responsive layout at 320/768/1024/1440,
keyboard navigation, skip-link, focus visibility, image alt text, reduced-motion, and no
horizontal overflow. These checks live here, not just in documentation.

---

## URLs

| Route | Viewport checks |
|-------|-----------------|
| `/` | 320 / 768 / 1024 / 1440 |
| `/?p=11` | 320 / 1440 |
| `/?p=12` (protected) | 1440 |

---

## Preconditions

- `blogware_e2e` seeded with posts; theme active.
- Playwright browser projects enabled for mobile viewports when the mobile spec runs.

---

## User Actions

- Resize viewport to 320/768/1024/1440 and assert no horizontal scroll.
- Tab through the page: skip-link is first focus target and reaches `#main-content`.
- Focus each interactive control and confirm a visible focus style (outline) is applied.
- Load with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and confirm no marquee/animation overrides
  fight it (no fatal JS).
- Confirm every `<img>` on key pages has `alt` (or `role="presentation"`/empty-alt for
  decorative).

---

## Expected Behaviour

- `document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= viewport width` at every breakpoint.
- Tabbing once from page load focuses the skip-link; activating it moves focus to
  `#main-content`.
- Interactive elements show `:focus-visible` outline (CSS `--focus-outline`).
- Images carry alt text.
- Reduced-motion does not break JS (no console errors).

---

## Validation Rules

- Per viewport: `await page.setViewportSize(...)`, reload, then
  `const overflow = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth -
  window.innerWidth); expect(overflow).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);`
- `page.keyboard.press('Tab')` then assert `document.activeElement` is `.skip-link`.
- Press Enter on skip-link and assert `document.activeElement.id === 'main-content'`.
- `locator('img:not([alt]), img[alt=""]')` count == 0 on home and single (allow placeholders
  with empty alt only if decorative - assert they have empty alt AND are within a link with
  aria-label).
- Reduced motion: `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` then assert no console
  errors on load.

---

## UI Components

- `.skip-link` in `header.php`.
- `#main-content` on all templates.
- Cards, nav toggler, dropdowns, forms.

---

## Accessibility

- Landmarks: `header role="banner"`, `main#main-content`, `nav[aria-label]`, `footer`.
- ARIA labels on menu toggle (`#al`), language menu (`#languageMenu`), social links.
- Focus-visible outline on interactive controls.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- No horizontal overflow at 320/768/1024/1440.
- Skip-link works and is first tab target.
- All images have alt.

High:
- Keyboard reaches every nav link and form field.
- Focus-visible styles present.
- Reduced-motion produces no JS errors.

Medium:
- Mobile nav toggler visible at 768 and collapses menu.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Generate `e2e/theme-ux-a11y.spec.js`. Use `test.describe` with per-breakpoint tests or a
loop over `[320, 768, 1024, 1440]`. Enable the mobile browser projects only for this spec
if desired. Run chromium/firefox/webkit.
